title: RSR-01a — SearXNG service + adapter + fake + budgets

service_config: Pinned service artifacts already delivered by T8 and verified against this task's needs: infra/podman/searxng/settings.yml (formats [html,json] explicit, limiter: false), compose searxng service (digest sha256:76f9ec5b..., backend internal:true + research-egress unpublished networks, healthcheck), versions.lock SEARXNG_VERSION=2026.9.20-2e624bed4, quadlet milpbooklm.network Internal=true
No Valkey service exists in compose (D7 minimal profile; limiter disabled precisely because it would require Valkey)

NEW infra/podman/searxng/README.md: pinning/revision-sync rule, the two verified facts (json format non-default; limiter depends on Valkey), network isolation, discovery-only wiring point, and the deferred real-instance smoke procedure
adapter: SearxngSearchService implements WebSearchPort: q/engines/categories/language/time_range params (engines+categories deduped and sorted), format=json always
Per-run budgets: wall-clock deadline via anyio.fail_after covering headers AND streamed body, result-count cap, response-byte cap
Strict content-type validation: media type must be application/json; unexpected types are typed refusals (a misconfigured instance answering HTML is rejected, never parsed)
Records URL/title/snippet + contributing engines per hit; unresponsive engines recorded; degraded/timeout upstreams degrade the answer to an EXPLICIT partial report
All-degraded engine list -> partial with all_engines_unresponsive, never a silent empty success (plan QA failure scenario)
Budget-exceeded result list -> truncated partial with budget_result_cap reason
Service-owned httpx client with aclose() and injectable transport (T22 pattern)
cache: CachedWebSearch (application decorator over the port): key = normalized query + sorted engines/categories + language + time_range + SearXNG config revision
Short TTL (default 120s) on an injectable monotonic clock; bounded LRU eviction (default 256 entries); only COMPLETE reports cached — partials/timeouts always re-queried; engine_health never cached
fake: FakeSearxng: deterministic in-process pure-ASGI app (no framework, no network, no running service) serving /search, /config, /healthz
Scenario-scriptable: results, unresponsive_hosts, content_type, status, delay, json_enabled (403-HTML format-gate emulation), raw_body, config_engines; records every request for parameter assertions
defect_fix_proven_adjacent: frozen+slots dataclass exceptions break under contextlib's __traceback__ reassignment inside anyio.fail_after scopes: T22's HardenedFetchService surfaced upstream HTTP errors as TypeError (proven by direct drive pre-fix)
WebFetchRefusedError and the new WebSearchRefusedError rewritten as hand-written typed exceptions (__slots__, typed fields, stable __str__); regression test added to tests/unit/test_hardened_fetch.py

cases: results mapped with params on the wire
all engines degraded -> explicit partial, no silent empty success
json format gate disabled -> 403 HTML -> http_status refusal
budget result cap -> partial with budget_result_cap reason
empty query refused before any request
